description: Tattoos Wizard helps people plan a tattoo before they book. Estimate what a tattoo typically costs at studios in 618 cities by size, level of detail and colour; find real tattoo artists and studios from the Tattoos Wizard directory (10,000+) by style and city, with portfolio images and profile links; and find practical guides on aftercare, healing, pain by placement, cost and styles. No account is needed, and every tool only reads public Tattoos Wizard data.
